data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season, and our village depends on us doing that. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50, and let it double back to 100. That’s $10,000 apiece each month for as long as we stick to it. I propose we agree to that equal limit and review everyone’s catches together afterward. John, would you be willing to commit to 10 tons?
